Fight endless minions, collect shiny gems and save the universe travelling through time! In this Action Roguelite, unlock a diverse cast of characters and weapons with unique powers, choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique and game-breaking builds

notes.title: Transitioning out of Free play
notes.notes:
In order to properly support the game, Link Wars is transitioning out of free play after Jun 9th.

Everyone who already added the game to their Steam library before the change will continue to own it and will not be affected by the change.

Thanks for understanding,
Lunar Chili team

notes.title: Achievements update
notes.notes:
Today's update brings Achievements to the game!
We added 11, spread between campaign and online matches.

You can check your progress in Steam, as always, or directly in the game "Compete" menu.

All new achievements are skill-based, some require a lot of skill !! Let the grinding begin!

Hope you guys enjoy.

As always, we are available in the Community Hub for any question or suggestion !

notes.title: Game balanced
notes.notes: Based on user feedback we made the game snappier when using tokens and launching rockets!
